module.name: holoscan-yolo26
module.description: End-to-end YOLO26 object detection on the GPU: a CUDA letterbox, TensorRT through the SDK's HoloInfer, and a GPU decode into boxes, scores, classes and a count; and a HoloViz overlay of the detections. The model is not included: a tool exports it with a separately installed Ultralytics (AGPL-3.0).

hardware.name: NVIDIA GPU
hardware.description: A CUDA-capable GPU supported by the Holoscan SDK, with TensorRT 10.

data.name: YOLO26 (Ultralytics, AGPL-3.0)
data.description: Not part of this module. Its tools/prepare_model.py downloads pinned weights and exports them to ONNX with the separately installed Ultralytics tool. The tests use a stub model that the module writes itself.
